# BetterHelp

> BetterHelp is the largest online therapy platform connecting users with 32,000+ licensed therapists for affordable, accessible mental health care via telehealth.

BetterHelp provides professional online therapy services with fast therapist matching, insurance coverage options, and support for various mental health conditions. The platform emphasizes accessibility, privacy compliance, and connections with credentialed mental health professionals including LCSWs, LMFTs, LPCs, and PhDs.

## Key Topics

- Online Therapy
- Licensed Therapists
- Therapist Matching
- Mental Health Services
- Telehealth
- Insurance Coverage
- HSA/FSA Benefits

- [Find a Therapist](https://www.betterhelp.com/therapists): Find and match with licensed therapists on BetterHelp platform
